यव 1. यव, अस्, m. Ved. the first half of
a month, (generally in the pl.; according to the
commentators = पूर्व-पक्षाः; also written याव.)

यव 2. यव, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1. यु), Ved.
warding off, keeping off, averting, preventing, re-
moving.

यव 3. यव, अस्, m. (perhaps connected
with rt. 2. यु), barley, (in the earliest times pro-
bably any grain or corn yielding flour or meal); a
barely-corn; (as a measure of length) a barley-corn
= (1/6) or (according to others) (1/8) of an अङ्गुल; (as a
weight) a barley-corn = 6 grains of white mustard
seed or (according to others) = 12 mustard seeds =
(1/2) गुञ्ज; (in palmistry) a figure or mark on the
hand resembling a barley-corn, a natural line across
the thumb at the second joint compared to a grain
of barley and supposed to indicate good fortune; N.
of a particular astronomical Yoga, (viz. when the
favourable planets are situated in the fourth and
tenth mansions and the unfavourable ones in the first
and seventh); speed, velocity (?); a double convex
lens (?); [cf. Zend yava; Gr. ζεά; Lith. jawa-s.]
—यव-क्री, ईस्, m. a buyer or purchaser of barley;
a proper N.; [cf. यव-क्रीत.]
—यव-क्रीत, अस्,
m. ‘purchased with barley,’ N. of a son of Bharad-
vāja.
—यव-क्षार, अस्, m. an alkali prepared
from the ashes of burnt barley-straw, saltpetre, nitre,
nitrate of potash.
—यव-क्षेत्र, अम्, n. a field of
barley.
—यव-क्षोद, अस्, m. barley-meal.
—यव-
खद, see Gaṇa Vrīhy-ādi to Pāṇ.

.
—यव-गोधूम-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, produced from
barley and wheat, prepared with barley and wheat.
—यव-ग्रीव, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. ‘barley-necked,’
whose neck is like a grain of barley (said of a fowl;
called also यव-शिरस्, q. v.).
—यव-चतुर्थी, f. a
sort of game played on the fourth day in the light
half of the month Vaiśākha (when people throw
barley-meal over one another).
—यव-चूर्ण, अस्,
अम्, m. n. barley-meal.
—यव-ज, अस्, m. = यव-
क्षार; Ptychotis Ajowan (= यवानी).
—यव-
तिक्ता, f. a species of plant (= शङ्खिनी).
—यव-
द्वीप, अस्, m. the island Yava, (also written जल-
द्वीप.)
—यव-नाल, अस्, m. a sort of grass or
grain, Andropogon Bicolor; barley-straw (?) .
—य-
वनाल-ज, अस्, m. an alkali made from the ashes
of the above plant, nitre; [cf. यव-क्षार.]
—य-
व-पिष्ट, अम्, n. barely-meal.
—यव-प्रख्य,
अस्, आ, अम्, resembling barley-meal; (आ), f., N. of a
particular eruption or small tumor like a barely-corn.
—यव-प्ररोह, अस्, m. a shoot or ear of barley.
—यव-फल, अस्, m. the bamboo cane; Indian
spikenard, Nardostachys Jatamansi; Wrightia Anti-
dysenterica; the tree Ficus Infectoria; an onion.
—यव-बुस, अम्, n. the husk or chaff of barley.
—यवबुसक, अस्, आ, अम्, (to be paid) at the time
of the production of barley-husk (as a debt; cf.
Pāṇini

).
—यव-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, pos-
sessing or abounding in barley; containing barley,
mixed with barley; (आन्), m., N. of a Gandharva;
of the author of a Vedic hymn; (अती), f. a kind of
metre, twice ¯ ˘ ¯ ˘ ¯ ˘ ¯ ˘ ¯ ˘ ¯ ˘, ˘ ¯ ˘ ¯ ˘ ¯ ˘
¯ ˘ ¯ ˘ ¯ ¯; (अत्), n. abundance of grain (Ved.).
—यव-मध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, having the middle
like a barely-corn, i. e. stout or broad in the centre
and thin or tapering at the ends; (अस्), m. a kind
of drum; (आ), f. a kind of metre; (अम्), n. a kind
of penance (= यव-मध्यम, q. v.); a particular
measure of length.
—यव-मध्यम, अम्, n. a
kind of lunar penance, (see चान्द्रायण.)
—यव-
मय, अस्, ई, अम्, consisting of barley, made of
[]
barley.
—यव-मात्र, अस्, ई, अम्, measuring a barley-
corn, as large as a grain of barley.
—यव-मुष्टि,
इस्, m. f. a handful of barley.
—यव-लास, अस्, m.
nitre, saltpetre.
—यव-वक्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having
a head or point like a grain of barley.
—यव-शिरस्,
आस्, आस्, अस्, having a head shaped like a grain of
barley, (see यव-ग्रीव.)
—यव-शूक or यव-
शूक-ज, अस्, m. = यव-क्षार, a kind of alkaline
salt prepared from the ashes of burnt barley-straw.
—यव-सुर, अम्, n. malt-liquor, an intoxicating
drink prepared from barley, beer.
—यवाकार (˚व-
आक्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, barley-shaped, shaped like a barley-
corn.
—यवाग्र-ज (˚व-अग्˚), अस्, m. = यव-
क्षार, N. of a plant, Ptychotis Ajowan (= य-
वानी).
—यवाग्रयण (˚व-आग्˚), अम्, n. the first-
lings or first-fruits of barley.
—यवाङ्कुर (˚व-अङ्˚),
अस्, m. a shoot or blade of barley.
—यवाचित (˚व-
आच्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, laden with barley.
—यवाद् (˚व-
अद्), त्, त्, त्, eating barley, living on barley.
—य-
वान्न (˚व-अन्˚), अम्, n. barley-food, boiled barley.
—यवापत्य (˚व-अप्˚), अम्, n. = यव-क्षार.
—यवाम्ल-ज (˚व-अम्˚), अम्, n. sour barley-
gruel.
—यवाशिर् (˚व-आश्˚), ईर्, ईर्, ईर्, mixed or
malted with barley.
—यवाहार (˚व-आह्˚), अस्, आ,
अम्, having barley for food, living on barley.
—य-
वाह्व (˚व-आह्˚), अस्, m. = यव-क्षार.
—यवोत्-
थ (˚व-उत्˚), अम्, n. = यवाम्ल-ज.
—यवोदर
(˚व-उद्˚), अम्, n. the body or thick part of a grain of
barley used as a measure of length.
—यवोर्वरा (˚व-
उर्˚), f., Ved. a filed sown with barley, barley-field.
याव 1. याव = 1. यव, q. v.

याव 2. याव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. 3. यव), relat-
ing to barley, consisting of barley, made or prepared
from barely, = यावक; (अस्), m. a kind of food
prepared from barley; lac or the red dye prepared
from the cochineal insect.
यवन्, आ, m. = 1. यव above.

1. यावन्, आ, m. (for 2. see p. 817, col. 1), Ved.
a rider, horseman, horse-soldier; an invader, aggres-
sor, enemy, (Sāy. = अभिगन्तृ); going, driving,
riding (at the end of a comp.; cf. अग्र-य्˚, पूर्व-
य्˚).

यावन् 2. यावन् = 1. यव. (For 1. यावन्
see p. 814, col. 2.)

यावन् 3. यावन् (fr. rt. 1. यु) in ऋण-यावन्,
q. v.; [cf. 2. यव.]

1. यव्य, अस्, m. (for 2. see col. 3), a month
(as containing a यव, see above).

2. यव्य, अस्, आ, अम् (for 1. यव्य see col. 2),
suitable or fit for barley; sown with or consisting of
barley; (अस्), m., Ved. a stock of barley or fruit;
(आस्), m. pl., N. of a family of Ṛṣis; (अम्), n. a
field of barley; (Ved.) epithet of certain Homa-
mantras; (आ), f., Ved. a river, stream (in Ṛg-veda
VIII. 98, 8
यव्य 1.2. यव्य. See p. 811, cols. 2,3.
याव्य याव्य. See col. 3.

याव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be joined or mixed, to be
united or mingled; miscible; = याप्य, unimportant,
insignificant.

यवयावन्, आ, m., Ved. one who keeps off or
averts.

यवक, अस्, m. barley; = यव-प्रकार, a sort
of barley.

यावक, अस्, अम्, m. n. a kind of food prepared
from barley, barley-gruel; half ripe barley; awnless
[]
barley; forced rice; a sort of kidney-bean; a kind
of pulse, Dolichos Biflorus; a kind of pulse said to
be peculiar to Kaśmīra; lac, the red dye.

यवक्य, अस्, आ, अम्, producing barley, sown with
barley, fit for barley.
यवक्षा, f., N. of a river.

यवयु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. desiring barley or corn,
(Sāy. = यवेच्छु.)

यवस, अम्, n. (according to some also अस्, m.),
grass, fodder, food, pasturage, pasture, meadow grass.
—यवस-प्रथम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. beginning
with or depending on good pasturage, well-nurtured;
(according to Mahī-dhara on Vājasaneyi-s.
XXI. 43

.
first or best of all kinds of food.)
—यवसाद् (˚स-
अद्), त्, त्, त्, Ved. eating or consuming grass, grazing,
pasturing, feeding.
—यवसान्नोदकेन्धन (˚स-
अन्न-उद्˚, ˚क-इन्˚), अम्, n. grass, corn, water, and
fuel.
—यवसोदक (˚स-उद्˚), ए, n. du. grass and
water.
यवस यवस. See p. 811, col. 3.

यवास, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. 2. यु), = यास,
Alhagi Maurorum; a species of Khadira; (आ), f. a
kind of grass (= गुण्डासिनी).
—यवास-शर्करा, f.
a kind of sugar made from Yavāsa.
यवाष यवाष = येवाष, q. v.

यावस यावस, अस्, m. (fr. यवस), a heap
or quantity of grass; fodder, provender, provisions.

यावास यावास (fr. यवास), see Gaṇa Pa-
lāśādi to Pāṇ.
यवागू, ऊस्, f. (in Uṇādi-s.

. said to come
fr. rt. 2. यु), sour gruel, rice-gruel (made from rice
boiled with water and said to be composed of six
measures of water to one of rice); any thin decoction
of other kinds of grain, &c., (according to some, a

down to half the original quantity.)
—यवागू-मय,
अस्, ई, अम्, consisting of Yavāgū.
यवागू यवागू. See p. 811, col. 3.
यवानिका, f. Ptychotis Ajowan.
यवानिका यवानिका. See p. 811, col. 3.
यवानी, f. a kind of bad barley; Ptychotis Ajowan.
यवासक, अस्, m. Alhagi Maurorum.
यवासिनी, f. a district abounding in Yavāsa.

यविक or यविल, अस्, आ, अम्, having or producing
barley.
यविन्, ई, इनी, इ, = यविक above.
यव्या-वती, f., Ved., N. of a river (in Ṛg-veda

, identified by Sāy. with Hariyūpīyā, which
he describes as the N. of a river or of a city); N. of
a district.
यवक्षार यव-क्षार. See col. 2.

यवगण्ड यवगण्ड, अस्, m. = युव-गण्ड,
a kind of eruption on the face.

यवन यवन, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. or 2. यु,
or connected with rt. जु = 1. जू), one who keeps
back; one who mixes, &c., see Gaṇa Nandyādi to
Pāṇ.

; a fast horse, courser, (in this sense
fr. rt. 1. जू and connected with जवन, for which it
is sometimes a false reading); speed, velocity, (con-
nected with rt. 1. जू); an Ionian, Greek, (in Uṇādi-s.

. said to be fr. rt. 2. यु); a king of the
Greeks; a Muhammadan, (sometimes applied to
both the Muhammadan and European invaders of
India as coming from the same quarter); any
foreigner; a barbarian generally (Manu

);
the country of the Yavanas (sometimes applied to
Bactria, Ionia, Greece, and more recently to Arabia);
a carrot; olibanum; (आस्), m. pl. the Ionians or
Greeks; the Greek astrologers; N. of a dynasty;
(ई), f. a Greek or Muhammadan woman; the wife
of a Yavana; = जवनी, a curtain.
—यवन-देश,
अस्, m. the country of the Yavanas.
—यवनदेश-
ज, ‘growing in the country of the Yavanas,’ styrax
or benzoin.
—यवन-द्विष्ट, अस्, m. ‘hated or
disliked by Yavanas,’ bdellium.
—यवन-पुर,
अम्, n. the city of the Yavanas, (probably) Alex-
andria.
—यवन-प्रिय, अम्, n. ‘dear to Yavanas,’
pepper.
—यवन-मुण्ड, अस्, m. a bald Yavana,
one with a shaved head.
—यवन-सेन, अस्, m. a
proper N.
—यवनाचार्य (˚न-आच्˚), अस्, m. an
astronomical writer (frequently quoted by Varāha-
mihira and other ancient Hindū astronomers, perhaps
any Greek astronomer).
—यवनारि (˚न-अरि), इस्,
m. ‘enemy of the Yavanas,’ N. of Kṛṣṇa or
Viṣṇu; of a king of Vārāṇasī.
—यवनेश्वर
(˚न-ईश्˚), अस्, m., N. of the author of the Mīna-
rāja-jātaka.
—यवनेष्ट (˚न-इष्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
liked by the Yavanas; (अस्), m. a kind of onion or
garlic; Azadirachta Indica; (आ), f. the wild date
tree; (अम्), n. lead; an onion, garlic; pepper.

यवान यवान, अस्, आ, अम्, quick, swift,
rash, (incorrectly for जवान, part. fr. rt. 1. जू.)

यावन 1. यावन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. यवन;
for 2. see col. 2, for 3. see col. 3), born or produced
in the land of the Yavanas; (अस्), m. incense (as
coming from the country of the Yavanas).

2. यावन, अम्, n. (fr. the Caus.; for 1. यावन
see col. 1, for 3. see col. 3), the act of removing or
keeping off.

3. यावन, अम्, n. (fr. the Caus.; for 1. see
col. 1, for 2. see col. 2), the act of uniting or join-
ing, mixing, mingling, blending.

यवनक, अस्, m. a particular kind of grain;
(इका), f. = यवनी, a Yavana woman; = जवनिका,
a curtain or screen, an outer tent, a screen of cloth
surrounding a tent; a veil.
यवनानी, f. the writing of the Yavanas.
यवनाल यव-नाल. See p. 811, col. 2.

यावनाल यावनाल, अस्, m. = यव-नाल,
q. v.; (ई), f. sugar extracted from Yava-nāla.
—या-
वनाल-निभ or यावनाल-शर, अस्, m. a kind
of cane or reed resembling the Yāvanāla.

यवय यवय (fr. युवन्), Nom. P. यव-
यति, -यितुम्, to make young.

यवयस यवयस, अम्, n., N. of a Varṣa
in Plaksha-dvīpa.
यवाषिक, see Gaṇa 1. Kumudādi to Pāṇ.
यवाषिन्, see Gaṇa Prekṣādi to Pāṇ.

यविष्ठ यविष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (superl. of
युवन्), youngest, very young, last-born; (अस्), m.
a younger brother; N. of Agni (called ‘the youngest’
or ‘last-born’ of the gods, either as produced from
wood or as placed on the altar after everything else);
N. of a Brāhman; (आस्), m. pl. his descendants;
अग्नि यविष्ठ, N. of the author of the hymn Ṛg-
veda
VIII. 91

; [cf. Old Germ. jungisto.] — 1. य-
विष्ठ-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, containing the word य-
विष्ठ.
—२. यविष्ठ-वत्, ind. like a youth.

यविष्ठ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. youngest, = य-
विष्ठ, (Sāy. = युवतम.)

यवीयस्, आन्, असी, अस् (compar. of युवन्),
younger; (आन्), m. a younger brother; a Śūdra (as
opposed to one of the three higher castes); (असी), f.
a younger sister; [cf. Goth. juhisa.]
यवीयस, अस्, m., N. of a preceptor.

यवीनर यवीनर, अस्, m., N. of a son of
Ajamīḍha; of a son of Dvimīḍha and of Bharmyāśva
and of Vāhyāśva.

यवीयुध् यवीयुध्, त्, त्, त् (fr. Intens. of rt.
1. युध्), Ved. eager to fight, fond of war, warlike,
(also written यव्युध्.)

यावक्रीतिक, अस्, m. (fr. यव-क्रीत), one con-
versant with the history of Yava-krīta.

यावत् यावत्, आन्, अती, अत् (fr. the pronom.
base 3. य; correlative of तावत्, q. v.), as great, as
large, as much, as many (= Lat. quot), as often, as
far, as long, how much, how many, of what sort
or kind, (for examples see तावत्); यावत्-तावत्,
‘quantum-tantum,’ an expression used in algebra
for the relation of the first unknown quantity and
its co-efficient); यावन्तः कियन्तः, as many as.
यावत्, ind. (i. e. acc. sing. neut. used adverbially),
as greatly, as much as, as many as, as often as; as far
as, as long as, while, whilst, during; meanwhile, in the
mean time; as soon as, the moment that; till, until,
until such a time as (with pres. or pot. or fut. or aor.
or impf.); that, in order that; when (followed by
the correlative तावत्, meaning ‘then’); even, just.
यावत् meaning ‘during,’ ‘for,’ ‘until,’ ‘up to,’ ‘as
far as,’ &c. is often used like a preposition with an
acc. (e. g. वर्षं यावत्, for a year; मासम्
एकं यावत्, during one month; यावद् वर्षाणि
द्वादश, for twelve years; शतं जन्मानि यावत्,
for a hundred births; सूर्योदयं यावत्, until
sunrise; सर्प-विवरं यावत्, up to the serpent's
hole); or with indeclinable words like अद्य (e. g.
अद्य यावत्, up to to-day); or sometimes with a
nominative followed by इति (e. g. अन्त
इति यावत्

, as
far as the end; त्रिंशद्
इति यावत्

, as many as thirty,
up to thirty; पञ्च यावद् इति, up to five); यावद्-आ
and sometimes even यावत् alone may be used with
a following abl. to express ‘up to,’ ‘as far as,’
‘until,’ &c. (e. g. यावद्-आ समापनात् or simply
यावत् समापनात्, until the completion); यावन्
न, as long as not, before that, until that; न
परम् or न केवलम् — यावत्, not only — but also;
यावता, ind. (i. e. inst. c. used adverbially), as far as,
as long as; up to, until; as soon as, the moment
that; यावति, ind. (i. e. loc. c. used adverbially),
as far as, as long as, &c.; [cf. Gr. ἧμος; Lat. quan-
tus?].
—यावच्-छक्यम्, ind. (i. e. यावत् + शक्-
यम्), as far as possible, according to ability.
—या-
वच्-छस्, ind. (i. e. यावत् + शस्), Ved. as often as,
as many times as, in as many ways as.
—यावच्-
छस्त्रम्, ind. (i. e. यावत् + श्˚), Ved. as far as
the Śastra extends.
—यावच्-छेषम्, ind. (i. e.
यावत् + श्˚), Ved. as much as is left, as many as
remain.
—यावच्-छ्रेष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (i. e. यावत्
+ श्˚), Ved. the best possible.
—यावच्-छ्लोकम्,
ind. (i. e. यावत् + श्˚), according to the number
of the Ślokas.
—यावज्-जन्म, ind. throughout
life, all one's life long.
—यावज्-जीवम् or यावज्-
जीवेन, ind. throughout life, during the whole
of life, for life, for the rest of life.
—यावज्जीविक,
अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. life-long, as long as life, lasting for
life.
